phase: Independent source-blind validator; before joint source/runner/input freeze and before any product execution

runnerContract.ledger: Each instance retains the fixed ordered planned checks and operation events; bookkeeping errors append explicit checks.

exitCodes.0: All checks pass with no publication errors.
exitCodes.1: At least one failed check, possibly with unavailable/error checks.
exitCodes.2: Unavailable/error/incomplete/setup/output failure without a failed check.

runnerContract.setupOutputFailure: May have no aggregate; stderr plus exit 2 must not be classified as a completed test.

beforeFreezeIntegrationConditions.condition: Set freeze.entrypointFileName to main.swift for this runner, which has top-level statements and no @main type. Do not package it under Runner.swift without separately validating that packaging.

Pass an absolute root to run-paired.py, or make the driver resolve root before changing subprocess cwd. Its argparse currently accepts relative roots, but binary/input output paths assembled from a relative root can fail or resolve incorrectly under empty-cwd.

A driver exit of zero is transport completion only. Require exactly two designated version records, buildExit=0 and productExecutions=1 per version, retained runExit, and independently valid full result accounting for each. Run output-accounting.py on both outputs with their recorded child exits. A build failure, missing output or interruption cannot pass.

The future joint freeze must hash this exact runner/input, the reviewed driver or a newly reviewed correction, each archive, and exact per-version Swift source manifests. Freeze path fields and the driver invocation must be concrete before execution. No freeze/source/archive was inspected in this review.

staticOracleReview.normalization: Independent Unicode casefold plus canonical decomposition and combining-mark removal; all declared normalizations agree. Whole normalized bytes equal per-source-character concatenation for the supplied inputs. No production normalizer called.
staticOracleReview.alignment: Normalized UTF-8 byte counts compared independently; corrected spelling need not match byte values.
staticOracleReview.samples: Per-source-character tap duplication across normalized bytes; missing and nil taps omitted; extra taps ignored; normalized intended a-z positions contribute. Ordered (target key, tap-center key, dx, dy) streams agree with explicit controls for every accepted call.
staticOracleReview.acceptance: Learning enabled, aligned length >=2, nonempty samples, only contributing displacements finite; persistent per-call limit <=40 samples. All annotations and expected Booleans agree.
staticOracleReview.weight: Accepted calls require finite strictly increased weight plus local-control equivalence. Rejections require bit-exact weight and every offset component, including signed zero. Fixed histories keep per-key sample totals below the approved decay domain; no numerical private weight constant asserted.
staticOracleReview.control: Nil-URL controls preserve call boundaries and sample order; rejected calls do not teach the control. Every accepted explicit control independently validates and has the same contributing stream.
staticOracleReview.status: Oversize calls assert invalid. Every observed busy aborts dependent evaluation as unavailable with zero retries; unspecified non-busy statuses are captured rather than invented.
staticOracleReview.denominator: 34 independently reconstructed ordered plans total 652; matches fixture, denominator manifest and ledger construction. Pass/fail/unavailable/error remain in the denominator.
staticOracleReview.filesystem: Fresh per-instance cwd; public authority must remain inside it. Rejection baselines occur after settled seeds and before any subsequent save. Recursive lstat snapshots compare membership, type, inode/device, bytes, symlink target, and exact mtime seconds/nanoseconds including directory root. Nil constructor/learn/save and nil controls are covered. No whole-host filesystem claim.
staticOracleReview.lifecycle: Synchronous settlement, save, reopen while original remains alive, and no-external-write reload checked; no registry release/epoch/race inference.

typecheck.compiler: Apple Swift 6.4, Swift language mode 6, arm64-apple-macosx15.0
typecheck.method: Compile declaration-only public map-derived .swiftinterface to a module, then swiftc -typecheck the exact author runner. No implementation bodies supplied, no link, no stub execution, no real product module/build.
typecheck.qualification: This checks calls against the supplied public map and available compiler; it does not certify an unavailable Swift 6.2 binary toolchain or the real product module. Initial validator setup/stub omissions were corrected before the reported successful check.

adversarialStaticChecks.interpretation: Static/synthetic expectation and JSON ledger predicate checks only; not executed runner behavior, mocked model evidence, product acceptance or a product result.
adversarialStaticChecks.mutations: Inverted acceptance, off-by-one sample annotations, reversed weight relations, wrong normalization, tapless controls, busy-as-invalid, nonfinite/tolerance/bit-pattern mismatches, filesystem mutations, hidden busy/errors, missing/duplicate/miscounted outputs, and inconsistent process exits are rejected.

driverReview.transport: Checks freeze file hashes, rejects archive path escape/links, recomputes exact extracted Swift source map against frozen per-version map, copies that core to an external client dependency, injects frozen runner, builds once and runs once per listed version, retains child stdout/stderr/exit and hashes, refuses an existing root. No retry loop.
driverReview.limits: Version count and completeness of the freeze files map are supplied by the future freeze, not enforced by this driver. Driver does not itself validate result JSON or propagate child nonzero exits. Its build invocation uses available swift rather than proving a specific compiler version. No actual source manifests, archives or product artifacts inspected.

provenance.authorAttestation: Read-set, manifest and attestation are hash-consistent. Actual historical author reads cannot be independently proved by self-attestation.

limitations: No product behavior has been observed or inferred.
Not a joint freeze or authorization to execute product.
Static output-accounting tool verifies retained structure/counts/exit consistency, not raw numerical truth or independent rerun of every numerical result.
Source/core ordinary mechanics remain separately admitted context; this review makes no additional finding about them.
